history.Gizmo to modułowy robot, który może łącz: Gizmo is a modular robot that can connect with other robots in different configurations — from manipulators to mobile platforms that work alongside people.
history.W rozwój projektu zaangażowane są równie: The KNR and Tapir student research groups also contribute to the project. Academic advisors are Assoc. Prof. Łukasz Kolimas, Dr Łukasz Makowski and Dr Witold Czajewski.
history.Pierwszy model składał się z dwóch dyskó: The first model consisted of two discs connected by a joint. It was our first attempt at creating the robot's body, inspired by continuum manipulators.
history.Model 1 celowo nie został wyposażony w j: Model 1 deliberately had no drive or control unit, as it was intended to explore the drive concept. The design allowed movement in three planes.
history.Sukces modelu 1 przyczynił się do zaproj: The success of Model 1 led to a test version. Equipped with three servos, this robot connected to other similar robots through a joint. Cables linking the robot body to the servo shafts enabled movement. The design had several drawbacks:
history.potrzeba kontroli napięcia linek jako je: Cable tension was the only way to control position
history.niekontrolowane obroty dysków względem p: The discs could rotate uncontrollably around the joint
history.Wady poprzednich modeli usunięto w zaimp: The implemented drive addressed the shortcomings of earlier models. It offered:
history.łatwością uzyskania zadanego wychylenia: Straightforward control of the desired angle
history.brakiem konieczności nadzorowania pozycj: No need to continuously monitor position
history.Model jednak nie zapewniał optymalnego m: The model still fell short of the ideal design. Its main drawbacks were:
history.konkretne wymagania co do ułożenia moduł: Strict module alignment requirements and a risk of damaging the tube
